name: WdSaveFormat
description: Specifies the format to use when saving a document.

constants.name: wdFormatDocument
constants.description: Microsoft Office Word 97 - 2003 binary file format.

constants.name: wdFormatTextLineBreaks
constants.description: Windows text format with line breaks preserved.

constants.name: wdFormatDOSTextLineBreaks
constants.description: Microsoft DOS text with line breaks preserved.

constants.name: wdFormatXMLDocumentMacroEnabled
constants.description: XML document format with macros enabled.

constants.name: wdFormatXMLTemplateMacroEnabled
constants.description: XML template format with macros enabled.

constants.name: wdFormatDocumentDefault
constants.description: Word default document file format. For Word, this is the DOCX format.

constants.name: wdFormatFlatXML
constants.description: Open XML file format saved as a single XML file.

constants.name: wdFormatFlatXMLMacroEnabled
constants.description: Open XML file format with macros enabled saved as a single XML file.

constants.name: wdFormatFlatXMLTemplate
constants.description: Open XML template format saved as a XML single file.

constants.name: wdFormatFlatXMLTemplateMacroEnabled
constants.description: Open XML template format with macros enabled saved as a single XML file.
